refreshCommands.standards: See docs/reference/github-repos.md for per-section refresh commands

idealEntry._note: Target state for all repos. Each review key shows the value a fully-compliant repo should have. Use this as a diff baseline during audits.

scorecard._scoreNote: Solo-dev structural ceiling ~7.5-8.0: Code-Review and Contributors checks require multiple contributors by definition. Floor 7.0 triggers investigation. Target 8.5 is achievable with automation.

renovate._note: Self-hosted Renovate (Docker). Uses helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver for org-wide SHA pinning and auto-merge for patch/minor dev dependencies.

ossfBadge._levelNote: Passing is the achievable solo-dev target. Silver is blocked by bus_factor>=2 and two_person_review. Gold adds contributors_unassociated. All three are structural blockers, not process gaps.

releaseHealth._note: For python-package and python-app types only. Flag if > 180 days since last GitHub Release.

templateDrift._note: null sourceTemplate means repo was not generated from a cookiecutter template. driftScore 0 = in sync.

python-package.description: Published Python package with src layout and PyPI release workflow.

python-app.description: Deployed Python application, no PyPI publishing.

python-script.description: Python scripts and automation tooling without formal packaging.

config.description: Configuration files, dotfiles, and settings repositories.

infrastructure.description: IaC, homelab, networking, Terraform, Ansible, or Helm repositories.

docs-only.description: Documentation sites, reference material, and GitHub Pages repos.

template.description: Cookiecutter or other project templates; may contain placeholder code.

private.description: Private repositories -- GitHub features and APIs that require public repo access are not applicable.
private._scorecardApiSkipNote: api.securityscorecards.dev does not index private repos; skip floor/target score evaluation and the live Scorecard API lookup entirely.
private._exemptChecksNote: bestpractices.coreinfrastructure.org badge API is designed for public OSS. Private repos are rarely registered; flag as EXEMPT rather than FINDING.
private._exemptWorkflowsNote: CodeQL GitHub Actions requires GitHub Advanced Security (paid) for private repos. Flag absent codeql.yml as EXEMPT rather than FINDING.
scopedNotes: GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (the 'Report a vulnerability' button on repo pages) is only available for public repos. The Scorecard 'Vulnerabilities' sub-check will return N/A -- log EXEMPT rather than FINDING.
GitHub Secret Scanning and Push Protection may be limited for private repos without GitHub Advanced Security. Treat secretScanning gaps as IMPORTANT rather than CRITICAL for private repos.
OSSF-002 (SECURITY.md private reporting channel) still applies: GitHub Security Advisories can be created manually on private repos. Document the reporting process even if PVR is unavailable.
